action: Place probe in transverse. Immediately adjust depth.
interpretation: Visualize the superior portion of the aorta in transverse.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take a nice big breath in.'
interpretation: Prepare patient for scanning.

action: Start sweeping probe. Ensure depth and focus remain set on the aorta.
interpretation: Identify the aorta located 'right here'.

action: Sweep probe all the way down. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally.'
interpretation: Follow the aorta distally.

action: Adjust gain.
interpretation: Optimize image brightness.

action: Move probe distally. Maintain current depth limits. Scan until the bifurcation.
interpretation: Visualize the aorta until it reaches the bifurcation.

action: Return probe to superior position for a second sweep. Instruct patient: 'Big breath in.'
interpretation: Perform mandatory second interrogation of the organ.

action: Instruct patient: 'Hold that breath.' Follow the aorta all the way down. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally.'
interpretation: Track the aorta distally.

action: Apply pressure at the mid-portion of the aorta.
interpretation: Recognize that breath holding is ineffective at mid-portion; rely on pressure.

action: Adjust depth. Adjust zoom. Move focus to be posterior to the aorta.
interpretation: Optimize image resolution and focal zone.

action: Adjust Time Gain Compensation (TGC).
interpretation: Ensure appropriate gain to prevent excessive reverb within the aorta.

action: Perform mini-sweeps through the aorta while moving distally.
interpretation: Verify there is 'nothing hanging off those sides of the walls'.

action: Scan through the midline, maintaining position through obstruction.
interpretation: Visualize through bowel gas.

action: Scan distally until the vessel tapers.
interpretation: Identify the tapering indicating the bifurcation.

action: Perform a final sweep all the way down. Sweep side-to-side through the structure.
interpretation: Confirm the aorta as the 'really strong tubular structure' located 'right here'.

action: Increase probe pressure to displace bowel gas. Check patient comfort.
interpretation: Overcome bowel gas obstruction.

action: Continue scanning. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally.'
interpretation: Maintain visualization while patient breathes.

action: Differentiate vessels to avoid interrogating the IVC.
interpretation: Identify the Inferior Vena Cava (IVC) by noting it is 'not as strong or pulsatile as the aorta'.

action: Position probe in transverse. Activate dual screen. Target the celiac axis/trunk.
interpretation: Use the celiac axis/trunk as a landmark for the superior portion image.

action: Instruct patient: 'Take a nice big breath in.'
interpretation: Prepare for superior image capture.

action: Freeze image. Instruct patient: 'Breathe normally.' Then instruct: 'Breath in.'
interpretation: Visualize 'lovely celiac axis'.

action: Hit update. Instruct patient: 'Breathe.'
interpretation: Retry image capture on dual screen.

action: Move to mid-portion. Use SMA as landmark. Observe anatomical layout.
interpretation: Visualize SMA. Note anatomical variant: IVC is on the left-hand side beside the aorta, rather than the typical right-hand side.

action: Acquire image. Begin annotation.
interpretation: Capture mid-aorta image.

action: Annotate image: 'Trans', 'Aorta', 'Superior', and 'Mid'.
interpretation: Label the dual screen image appropriately.

action: Take one image without calipers. Take one image with calipers at mid-aorta level. Measure from outer wall to outer wall.
interpretation: Observe measurement is approximately 1.7. Ensure measurement is done in transverse plane.

action: Scan distally to bifurcation. Return to transverse. Activate dual screen.
interpretation: Prepare for distal bifurcation imaging.

action: Assess focus position. Maintain current focus. Activate dual.
interpretation: Optimize settings for distal image.

action: Locate bifurcation. Annotate: 'Trans AO distal'.
interpretation: Visualize bifurcation.

action: Type annotation: 'Bifurcation'.
interpretation: Complete labeling.

action: Rotate probe 90 degrees to longitudinal. Position for superior image.
interpretation: Prepare for longitudinal scan.

action: Target aorta at the diaphragm. Instruct patient: 'Big breath in.'
interpretation: Visualize aorta emerging 'right by the diaphragm'.

action: Instruct patient: 'Hold in that breath.' Scan superior aorta.
interpretation: Monitor for reverb within aorta. Ensure liver does not appear too hypoechoic.

action: Instruct patient: 'Breathe.' Annotate: 'Long Aorta' and 'Superior'. Slide to mid-aorta.
interpretation: Capture and label superior longitudinal view.

action: Center the aorta in the image.
interpretation: Ensure strongest beams by keeping aorta in the middle portion of the image.

action: Look at patient for orientation. Scan for SMA branching off aorta.
interpretation: Confirm mid-portion location by identifying the SMA.

action: Capture mid-image. Move to distal/inferior aorta. Adjust angle coronally.
interpretation: Look for 'tuning fork appearance'. Identify IVC posterior to the aorta.

action: Confirm distal level. Move focus.
interpretation: Be confident of distal level location.

action: Adjust TGCs.
interpretation: Ensure lumen looks 'nice and anechoic'.
